summary: The market is flat near the day's lows into the afternoon. The Nifty is holding a loss of about 1.36%, heavyweights like Adani Ports and L&T lead the drag, and mid- and smallcaps stay deep in the red.

detail.laggards: Adani Ports, L&T (lead the Sensex drag); Hindalco, Max Healthcare, Kotak; MidCap −1.31%, SmallCap −1.43%
detail.tone: No change in direction from 12:30: the Nifty at 22,825.25 (−315.25) at 1 pm is a touch below noon's 22,829. Brent pushing to fresh highs is keeping buyers away.
